definitions: To be judged by future generations as having been on the morally or intellectually incorrect position regarding a significant issue.
To hold views or take actions that will eventually be seen as outdated, unjust, or misguided.
examples: Those who opposed civil rights were on the wrong side of history.
Future generations will see that stance as being on the wrong side of history.
He warned that their policy put them on the wrong side of history.
